mapper.sql: select id, biz_type, biz_id, task_id, member_id, reason, evidence_json, state, due_at, handled_by, handled_at, created_at from audit_appeal
mapper.insert: insert into audit_appeal(biz_type, biz_id, task_id, member_id, reason, evidence_json, state, due_at, created_at) values (#{bizType}, #{bizId}, #{taskId}, #{memberId}, #{reason}, #{evidenceJson}, #{state}, #{dueAt}, #{createdAt})
mapper.select: where biz_type = #{bizType} and biz_id = #{bizId} and member_id = #{memberId}
where task_id = #{taskId} order by id desc limit 1 for update
mapper.update: update audit_appeal set state = 'REVIEWING' where task_id = #{taskId} and state = 'SUBMITTED'
